notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods, sacrificing Relentless Dead and Gravecrawler.
Thornbite Staff, Pitiless Plunderer, and Relentless Dead trigger on the stack; resolve them in that order.
Untap Priest of Forgotten Gods with Thornbite Staff.
Pitiless Plunderer creates two Treasure tokens; crack them both to float two {B}.
Resolve Relentless Dead's trigger, paying {B} to recur it to hand.
Resolve Priest of Forgotten Gods' activated ability; draw a card and add two {B} (floating three {B}).
Cast Relentless Dead from your hand, then cast Gravecrawler from the graveyard as you control a Zombie.
Repeat the combo from the first step, draining opponent with each activation of Priest of Forgotten Gods and drawing your library.
